intendedUse: Normalize a current Greek five-digit postcode, retrieve its rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and show a translucent context area with source, reference date, classification and confidence.
recordGrain: one current ELTA postcode assignment and its postcode-specific real area or truthful unavailable result

m2Definition.definition: A current rights-cleared ELTA nationwide five-digit assignment denominator and postcode-specific Polygon/MultiPolygon release are pinned by edition, validity, terms, SHA-256, coverage and non-geographic exceptions, published as an approved immutable artifact, and pass the real GR loader, API and app search-to-translucent-area path. ELTA web-search results, GISCO or GeoNames points and NUTS matches, ELSTAT census or cartographic boundaries, cadastral parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells, synthetic fixtures, and invented route, PO box or organization surfaces never satisfy M2.

officialObservations.finding: The current ELTA public page supports street or village search. No bulk assignment download, polygon release, API licence or finder-specific redistribution grant was found on the captured page.

GISCO explicitly describes a postal-code point dataset under CC BY-SA 4.0. Non-geographic codes are excluded and omissions or incorrect locations may exist; points are not ELTA postal-area perimeters.
The current index identifies Postal codes 2025 with reference date 2025-01-01.
Postal codes 2025 was released 2026-04-14 and received location and island-assignment corrections 2026-06-19.

The Greece row records zero member-state postal dataset rows, zero member-state address rows, 1,041 rows carried from GISCO Postal Code 2020, zero manual rows and GeoNames as the primary source. It does not establish ELTA completeness or postal polygons.
The ZIP contains one CSV with only NUTS3 and CODE columns. It has 1,041 unique five-digit codes and no coordinates or geometry.
ELSTAT publishes census-vintage cartographic descriptions, including 2021 localities and street axes and older blocks/buildings. These are statistical/census layers, not current postcode membership.
Cartographic material is obtained through a registered request and product declaration, not an anonymous unrestricted bulk release.
The request declaration limits cartographic material to the stated purpose, forbids reprinting or issuing a new map and forbids supplying it to third parties; no request or acceptance occurred.

ELSTAT encourages reuse of website and statistical content with attribution and modification notice, subject to listed exceptions; this general page does not override product-specific cartographic request terms.
The PDF visually confirms general free reuse with attribution/modification notice and exceptions for third-party material and the ELSTAT logo.

dataQuality.risk: The 1,041-row TERCET crosswalk is internally unique and format-valid but is not a complete ELTA assignment denominator and contains no geometry. GISCO points and NUTS matches can support coarse validation only; ELSTAT census/cartographic layers cannot be relabelled as postal areas.

browserReview.reason: No real rights-cleared GR Polygon/MultiPolygon exists to exercise. Deterministic shared UI tests verify capability without presenting synthetic geometry as Greek M2 evidence.

pdfReview.finding: The visible TERCET row and headers match the extracted values, and the ELSTAT reuse page is legible without clipping or overlap.

visualizationDecision.reason: An exact source/geometry matrix communicates the one-country evidence more faithfully than a chart, and no spatial surface exists to map.

blockerSummary: No current rights-cleared ELTA nationwide assignment denominator or postcode-specific Polygon/MultiPolygon release was found. The current official-derived evidence is a point/crosswalk lineage with 1,041 GeoNames-origin codes and explicit completeness/location caveats; ELSTAT cartography is census/statistical and request-controlled.
unblockConditions: Obtain an authoritative current ELTA nationwide assignment release with product-specific reuse and redistribution terms, reference date, edition, exceptions, bytes and SHA-256.

Obtain an official or explicitly derived rights-cleared postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon release with complete method, membership, exclusions, validity, CRS, coverage, uncertainty, attribution and digest.
Publish an approved immutable artifact without raw personal, address, cadastral or land-right data and preserve official, derived, virtual and unavailable classifications.
Pass real GR normalization, loader, API, geometry validation, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
